title: spec: declare what an ABSENT `scale` means per numeric field type — `percent ⇒ 0` — the `@objectstack/spec` half of objectstack-ai/objectui#9843 (ruled A′)
body:
Filed by the triage seat (`session_01KYzNJPin9Ar4oMMkSh4S9h`) at 2026-09-20T14:20Z as the **spec half** of the cross-repo work ruled on objectstack-ai/objectui#9843. ⛔ Not claimed, ⛔ not dispatched.

## Why this card exists in THIS repo

The ruling (director seat, summon #25 batch #194 item 1, **letter A′**, maintainer 「同意」, `objectstack-ai/objectui` `issuecomment-5749111840`) puts step 1 in `@objectstack/spec`:

> `@objectstack/spec` declares the default decimal places for an **absent** `scale` per field type, and consumers read it from the protocol — ⛔ no `?? N` in any consumer. **percent ⇒ 0** in this card.

〈多仓协调〉 rule 1: 「issue 住在修复落地的仓」. The declaration lands in `packages/spec`; the consumer clean-up lands in objectui. ⇒ rule 2: 「跨仓 feature 永不是一次派发:父单 + 每仓一 sub-issue,**spec/后端先行**」. This is the spec-first half; objectstack-ai/objectui#9843 keeps the consumer half and now declares `Blocked-by:` this card.

## The measurement the ruling rests on (⛔ carried, not re-derived)

`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:1213-1214` declares `scale` as `.optional()` with **no** `.default()`. Five consumers each invented the absent value — four `?? 0`, the edit widget `2` — so one stored `0.25` renders as **`25%`** on one face and **`25.00%`** on another, from a single empty declaration.

## Scope of THIS card

1. **percent ⇒ 0**, declared in the protocol.
2. **number** and **currency** ride the same PR **only** if a consumer census on `origin/main` shows one consistent absent-value per type. Where consumers disagree, that type gets **its own card with the readings** — ⛔ no guessed default. ⚠️ The ruling names why: a global `0` would turn an undeclared currency from `$25.00` into `$25`, which is exactly why plain **A** was refused.
3. **Shape is measured first, ⛔ not assumed**: if `FieldSchema` is a per-type union, `.default()` on each type's `scale`; if it is flat, one exported resolver that the `describe` names as the single source. Either way the `describe` must state the absent value **in words an author can read** — that is the ③ facet of the ruling, and `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`〈优先级〉4:「写给 AI 的文档与 skills 说错一句,等于产品缺陷」.

⛔ Out of scope here: removing the five `?? N` fallbacks. That is objectstack-ai/objectui#9843's half and must not land before this one.

## Adjacent, ⛔ not a duplicate

**objectstack-ai/objectstack#19320** — 「ruling B's percent storage derivation is NOT live」 — is about how a percent value is **stored/derived**, not about what an **absent `scale`** means when rendering. Different key, different ruling. Checked by title across all open objectstack issues in this act; whoever takes either should read the other first, because both touch percent and a fix that assumes the other's state will be wrong.

Refs: objectstack-ai/objectui#9843 (the consumer half + the ruling) · objectstack-ai/objectui#9568 (「Whether the two faces should agree at all needs its own ruling」 — this is that ruling, executed) · objectstack-ai/objectstack#19320 (adjacent)
